name: Komori Yasumi
source: A girl who became a recluse after finding human relationships way too troublesome to maintain. She is also an acquaintance of Shinji in an online game, and is actually married to him in the game. She even calls herself his wife in real life. Yasumi became one of the wife candidates in order ensure that her "husband" wouldn't be cheating on her with other girls.
